# MediLab Nexus Workspace Instructions

- Build for secure online diagnostic operations first; optimize for reliable web access and connected workflows.
- Preserve the Patient Trace Code format: initials plus sequential number.
- Keep the Prisma schema compatible with future PostgreSQL migration.
- Favor focused changes over broad refactors.
- Treat laboratory and imaging workflows as first-class modules.
- Keep billing, inventory, quality control, and compliance data connected to the operational workflow.
- Keep sync metadata and integration state visible without depending on browser-side offline queueing.
